senses.gloss: (b. h.; cmp. כזז) [to shrink, cmp. כָּחַשׁ,] to fail, dry up (of watercourses); to be false, to lie; to flatter.
units: <cite ref="Tosefta Parah 9:1">Tosef. Par. IX</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Parah 8:2">VIII</cite>), 2 <he>מפני שכָּזְבָה וכ׳</he> because it gave out during the war.—

<cite ref="Sanhedrin 82b:9">Snh. 82ᵇ</cite> (play on <he>כזבי</he>, <cite ref="Numbers 25:15">Num. XXV, 15</cite>) <he>כזבה באביה</he> she was false to her father (in disobeying his instructions). Tanḥ. Sh’laḥ 5 <he>לא כָזַבְתִּי לך</he> I did not tell thee a falsehood; a. e.

<cite ref="Mishnah Parah 8:9">Par. VIII, 9</cite> <he>המים המְכַזְּבִים</he> waters which fail at certain times. Y. Taan. II, 65ᵇ bot. (ref. to <cite ref="Numbers 23:19">Num. XXIII, 19</cite>) <he>אם יאמר … מְכַזֵּב הוא</he> if a man says, I am a God, he is a deceiver.

<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 23:8">Num. R. s. 23</cite> (ref. to Num. l. c.) <he>איש עושה לאל שיְכַזֵּב</he> a man (through his prayer) may cause God to fail (to execute his evil decrees); Tanḥ. Masé 7 <he>לא איש עושה לאל שיכ׳</he> does not a man cause God &c.?—

Yoma 69ᵇ לא כִיזְּבוּ לו Ms. M. (ed. בו) they would not be false in His praise (flatter); a. fr.—Part. pass. מְכוּזָּב, pl. מְכוּזָּבִים reduced. Ruth. R. to I, 1 (play on כזבה, I Chr. IV, 22) אלו בניו שהיו מכ׳ that refers to his (Elimelech’s) sons who were reduced (died).
